# NIST PFAS External Data

This folder contains external PFAS datasets downloaded from the NIST PFAS repository.

Source:
https://github.com/usnistgov/NISTPFAS

These datasets are used for:
- PFAS name mapping
- CAS validation
- SMILES lookup
- formula generation
- suspect screening
- descriptor enrichment
- mass spectrometry workflows

Raw files should remain unchanged.
